novelty_search.nearest_result: Direction-matched task-pair support jumps bidirectionally from subthreshold resid9 to a stable resid10 onset, while H1/H4 are already known as shared temporal-context readers. No component test attributes the cross-task answer-vocabulary jump.
novelty_search.new_question: Is block9 task-pair selection carried by full attention, MLP9, the reused temporal H1/H4 heads, or their seven-head complement?

population: The same 16 occupation- and direction-matched cross-task A1 pairs in both orientations.

operator.intervention: Replace only the recipient final-token component with the paired other-task native donor component; score answer-pair support and donor-task temporal correctness with the frozen four-logit instrument.
operator.no_rescue: No module, head set, score, row, orientation, or threshold change after execution.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_identity_and: All hashes, pairing, capability, identical token, cache identity, finite coverage, and attn9 all-head versus module agreement <=1e-5 pass.
predictions.pred_b_resid10_ceiling_recurrence: Bidirectional resid10 recovery remains within 0.05 of 0.8365237052169481 and 0.7629185997080772, with direction fraction 1.0.
predictions.pred_c_block9_component_localization: At least one of full attn9 or MLP9 retains >=0.50 of the resid10 recovery with direction fraction >=0.75 in both orientations.
predictions.pred_d_task_branch_outside_shared_tempor: The seven-head attention complement has greater mean task recovery than H1/H4 in both orientations and retains >=0.60 of full-attn9 recovery wherever full-attn9 recovery is positive.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 14 forwards/224 examples, 12 component-orientation arms, zero fit/search/backward/update.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: localize the block9 task-pair branch outside the shared H1/H4 temporal readers and nominate its live module route.
terminal.null: Instrument and ceiling pass but component localization or the registered head split misses.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, identity, route equivalence, ceiling recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.
